# oneprovider_rdns (Resource)

OneProvider reverse DNS resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set reverse DNS for a VM's IP
resource "oneprovider_rdns" "example" {
  ip_address = "192.168.1.100"
  domain     = "myserver.example.com"
}

# Update reverse DNS
resource "oneprovider_rdns" "example" {
  ip_address = "192.168.1.100"
  domain     = "new-name.example.com"
}

# Remove reverse DNS (set domain to empty)
resource "oneprovider_rdns" "example" {
  ip_address = "192.168.1.100"
  domain     = ""
}

# Import existing RDNS:
# terraform import oneprovider_rdns.example 192.168.1.100
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The IP address
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The reverse DNS hostname
- `vm_id` (String) VM ID (required for create)

### Read-Only

- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds
